cases: all 26 frozen SIM-030 synthesis cases, both cx and rzz targets (52 rows)
methods: all five explicit strategies plus best_native; baseline and candidate paired; all three original conventional Qiskit baselines
timing: one warmup, seven repeats, rotate method order each repetition; raw-descriptor end-to-end including conversion, decomposition, synthesis and full-operator/native-target validation
selection: no cherry-picking; unavailable rows retained; no speed threshold for pass
correctness: every available output operator error <=1e-10; explicit baseline/candidate instruction digests must match across all successful samples; matching availability for each strategy and target
limits: local synthetic targets only, no hardware, no paid/provider calls; Qiskit 2.5.1 pinned for replay; no general Qiskit parity or superiority claim
revision_reason: Independent review found inherited TimeoutError could be swallowed by factory exception handlers. Rerun with BaseException sentinel unwinding outside synthesis. Original first-pass raw.json retained, no results used to choose cases or methods.
timing_caveat: Seven repetitions partially rotate fifteen methods; this is not a fully counterbalanced experiment.
